featured_reviews.name: K Love
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently did a Facial, Hair Color, and Hair Spa here. The place is super clean and hygienic, but the services are a complete rip-off for the price they charge.

I paid ₹7,500 for a facial and it was extremely disappointing. I clearly told the aesthetician that my skin is sensitive and that I wanted a facial focused on massage, not layers of thick face packs. Unfortunately, she did the exact opposite — it was just a series of face packs with long waiting periods under them (over 40 minutes!). She neither did any proper blackhead or whitehead extraction, nor did my skin look any cleaner afterward. The massage was minimal and had no pressure at all — it didn’t even feel like she was touching my skin. For such a steep price, it was an absolutely poor experience.

The hair color and hair spa were handled by Nisarg, who did a great job, and was very professional. Did an amazing job to my hair, with his knowledge and the type of hair I have.  However, I was disappointed to find that Salon only offers two hair color brands, none of which are ammonia-free. The L’Oréal color cost ₹6,500, and the hair spa ₹3,000 — again, way overpriced.

Even after a 30% discount, my total bill was ₹12,000, which still felt unjustified for the type of service.

To top it off, the checkout experience was unprofessional. They asked if I could pay half in cash because their “credit card machine wasn’t working” — but magically it worked when I refused. Clearly, they were just trying to avoid card transaction fees.

Overall: Clean salon, but prices are inflated for the type of the service they provide. The offerings doesn’t match the rates, and the professionalism at checkout is questionable.
I will never return unless prices and service standards are fixed.
